terminal_predecessor_evidence.policy: V25 is immutable and will not be amended, retested, or reclassified. V26 is a fresh backend and artifact identity.

frozen_design.admitted_shape: Unanchored exact byte literals, widths 6 through 32 inclusive, that satisfy the unchanged V17/V25 cyclic-phase-unique five-column admission rule.

short_graph.reason: the sixth-column and persistent-wide setup has fixed code and runtime cost that short confirmations do not amortize

wide_graph.reason: wider confirmations provide enough avoided exact-compare work to amortize V25's additional screening

artifact_contract: Every admitted object is sealed as Search V26/backend 39 with AOT magic final byte 0x27.
The selected internal graph is recomputed independently from the authenticated literal width by both emitter and auditor.
Widths 6 through 8 must have instruction, label, relocation, and emission-work parity with a separately emitted authenticated V17 object for the same KIR.
Widths 9 through 32 must have instruction, label, relocation, and emission-work parity with a separately emitted authenticated V25 object for the same KIR.
V26 AOT and artifact identities remain distinct from both source backends even when machine code is equal.
forbidden_changes: no changes to V17 or V25 emitted bytes, manifests, AOT, or artifact identities
no lookup keyed by literal bytes, topology, benchmark name, or prior result
no Rebar pattern, result, or routing input
no LLVM, external assembler, or system compiler in native code generation
no production/default routing change in this candidate commit
no V25 rerun or amended V25 gate

fresh_synthetic_population.generator: For each width 6..32, output kind Exists/Span/SelectedEnd, and ordinal 0..15, derive bytes from repeated SHA-256(domain || width_le16 || output_tag_u8 || ordinal_le16 || block_counter_le32), rejecting and advancing the ordinal if the ordinary cyclic-phase-unique admission rule refuses the literal.
fresh_synthetic_population.freshness: The domain and generated population were frozen here before V26 implementation, compilation, execution, or timing. The generator does not read V24/V25 qualification inputs, Rebar, or result files.

requirements: exact V26 routing at widths 6, 8, 9, and 32 and rejection outside 6..32
emitter/auditor codegen-source agreement for every admitted width
semantic equality with KIR across all output kinds and frozen fresh synthetic window shapes
exact V17 machine-object parity at widths 6..8 and exact V25 machine-object parity at widths 9..32
V26 artifact/AOT distinction and round-trip preservation
rejection of V17/V25/V26 relabeling and width/manifest/code mutations
bounded work and resource-limit failures remain transactional
runtime publication admits authenticated V26 objects without changing the production default

measurements: candidate and selected-source emission wall time
local_static_benchmark.estimator: For wall time, arithmetic median of 11 alternating candidate/source batches after two untimed warmups; static object counts are exact.

future_disjoint_performance_gate.status: DESIGN_FROZEN_INPUTS; EXECUTION REQUIRES A SEPARATE SEALED RUNNER AND RECEIPT
future_disjoint_performance_gate.cell_estimator: Median of 12 paired candidate/reference ratios with all six execution orders occurring twice.

result_policy.pass: May proceed to a separately frozen external heldout gate; this preregistration alone grants no production authority.
result_policy.fail: Terminally refuse this exact V26 identity; do not retest, tune its gate, or deploy it.
